summary: Completed testing of CraftBolt new features (iteration 2). Fixed 2 bugs: missing X icon import in RegisterPage.jsx and missing ref declarations in DemandDetail.jsx. All backend tests pass (10/10, 2 skipped due to no test data). Frontend features verified: category filter, clickable stat cards, chat polling code, status notification banners.
